verdict.rationale: Canny's own docs say Autopilot automatically captures feedback from support, sales, and review platforms. Named sources cover each category: Gong, Fathom and Fireflies for sales calls, Intercom for support/chat, and Slack for chat. Missing for 10: detailed per-integration setup and docs for the support and chat tools (only marketing-level one-liners), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect feedback capture to support, sales, and chat tools I already use

citations.quote: Automatically capture feedback from Gong, Intercom, Slack, and dozens of other sources
